resolution.note: ci wait prints 'gate: success <head> in run <id>' from the Check details_url; test/ci/wait.test.ts

title: pr ship and ci wait print the Check run id of a successful gate
body:
Why: four lanes on 2026-11-14 (#837 #838 #839 #840) reported they could not name the Check run id because `bin/krn pr ship` prints only `gate: success <head>`; the run id exists in the check run details_url, so a lane's evidence line lacks it.
Outcome: on success `krn ci wait` (and so `krn pr ship`) prints `gate: success <head> in run <id>` when the Check run's details_url names an Actions run.
Proof: test/ci/wait.test.ts feeds a check run with details_url .../actions/runs/123/job/4 and asserts the line names run 123.
